info.name: AppConnect V3 Account Services Events API

params.name: event_status
params.description: Use to return only events that meet the specified status. Acceptable values include `ACTIVE`,`DRAFT`, `COMPLETE`, `DELETED`,`CANCELLED`, and `ERROR`.

params.name: search_text
params.description: Use to return only events that include the specified text.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Use to sort resulting events by one of the following properties: `name`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `created_time`, or `updated_time`.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order for the `sort_by parameter`. Accepted values include `ASC` (ascending) or `DESC` (descending). Defaults to `ASC` if `sort_by` is provided.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results to return per page. Default and maximum is `100`.

params.name: prev
params.description: Cursor for retrieving the previous page of results. This value is obtained from the `prev_cursor` field in a previous response.

params.name: next
params.description: Cursor for retrieving the next page of results. This value is obtained from the `next_cursor` field in a previous response.

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of events with event details.

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the new event. If not provided, a default name will be generated.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, defaults to a future date.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, defaults to one hour after start time.

params.name: placeholder_campaign_id
params.description: Placeholder campaign ID for the event.

items.docs: Creates a new event with default settings, registration form, and landing page. The event will be created in DRAFT status.

info.name: GET details for a single event.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: include
params.description: Use to include (`true`) or exclude (`false`) event setting properties in the results.

items.docs: Specify the `event_id` path parameter to retrieve the event's details.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event to update.

items.docs: Partially updates an event with the provided fields. Only the specified fields will be updated. This endpoint only works for events in DRAFT or ACTIVE status. Events in COMPLETE, CANCELED, or DELETED status cannot be updated.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID of the event to copy.

items.docs: Creates a deep copy of an existing event with all its settings, registration forms, and landing pages. The copied event is created in DRAFT status. Events in DRAFT, ACTIVE, COMPLETE, or CANCELED status can be copied. DELETED events cannot be copied.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to mark one or more tickets as checked in. The event must be in `ACTIVE` or `COMPLETE` status. Tickets with `CANCELLED` status cannot be checked in (returns HTTP 400).

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to undo check-in for one or more tickets, marking them as not checked in. The event must be in `ACTIVE` or `COMPLETE` status.

info.name: Get registration details for an event.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: track_id
params.description: The track key that uniquely identifies the event track.

params.name: registration_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the registration.

items.docs: Use the `event_id`, `registration_id`, and `track_id` path parameters to get registration details.

info.name: Get a list of registrations for an event.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: track_id
params.description: The track ID that uniquely identifies the event track.

params.name: registration_status
params.description: Filter registration results by status.

params.name: payment_status
params.description: Filter registration results by payment status.

params.name: search_text
params.description: Filter registration results by first name, last name, or email address.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Specify the field to use to sort the results.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Use to specify how you want the results sorted.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Alternative to the limit parameter to limit the number of results returned per page. If specifying both the limit and page_size query parameters, they must be the same value.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results returned per page. If specifying both the limit and page_size query parameters, they must be the same value.

params.name: prev
params.description: Cursor for pagination used to get the previous page of results (mutually exclusive with next).

params.name: next
params.description: Cursor for pagination used to get the next page of results (mutually exclusive with prev).

items.docs: Use the `event_id` and `track_id` path parameters to get a list of registrations for an event. Use optional query parameters to limit the number of results returned per page, the sort order, or to filter results by specific criteria; such as registration `status`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: track_id
params.description: The track key that uniquely identifies the event track.

params.name: increase_count
params.description: Override count flag.

params.name: increase_item_count
params.description: Override item count flag.

params.name: return_items_to_inventory
params.description: Return items to inventory flag. Defaults to `true`.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to update the registration status for one or more registrations within an event track.

info.name: Update payment status for event registrations.

params.name: event_id
params.description: The ID that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: track_id
params.description: The track key that uniquely identifies the event track.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to update the payment status for one or more registrations. This endpoint only processes registrations with a payment method (PAYPAL, WEPAY, STRIPE, DOOR, or CHECK). Free registrations without a payment method are silently excluded.
